info.name: Unisys Stealth Eco Combined Isolation API

items.docs: Simultaneously isolate both an endpoint and a user from the Stealth zero trust network in a single API call. This is useful when responding to a security incident that requires immediate isolation of both the compromised machine and the associated user account.

Simultaneously remove the isolation state from both an endpoint and a user in the Stealth network in a single API call. This restores the machine and user to their normal Stealth community memberships and role assignments.
